# World Bank

> The World Bank is a global development institution providing research, financing, and programs to reduce poverty and promote sustainable economic growth in developing countries.

The World Bank Group operates through multiple initiatives focused on job creation, agricultural transformation, energy access, and health systems strengthening across Africa, Asia, Latin America, and other developing regions. The organization publishes extensive research, economic forecasts, and policy frameworks to guide development efforts worldwide.

## Key Topics

- job creation
- poverty reduction
- economic development
- climate resilience
- agricultural transformation
- smallholder farming
- food security
- youth employment
- sustainable economies
- universal health coverage
- renewable energy
- Sub-Saharan Africa
- economic analysis
- value chains
- development financing

## Flagship Development Programs

- [Creating Jobs for a Better Future](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/jobs): World Bank Group's job creation initiative empowering youth, women, and small businesses globally
- [Mission 300 is Powering Africa](https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/energizing-africa): Mission 300 initiative scaling electrification across Sub-Saharan Africa with partners
- [AgriConnect: Agribusiness, Jobs & Subsistence Farming](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/agriconnect): AgriConnect program transforming smallholder farming and strengthening food security
- [Health Works](https://www.worldbank.org/en/programs/health-works): Health Works program improving universal health coverage and affordable healthcare access

## Research & Economic Analysis

- [Research](https://www.worldbank.org/en/research): World Bank research hub providing data, publications, and development research from experts
- [Global Economic Prospects](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/global-economic-prospects): Global economic outlook and forecasts on GDP growth, inflation, and development trends
- [Digital Progress and Trends Report 2025: AI Foundations](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/dptr2025-ai-foundations): Report on AI adoption and Small AI solutions for inclusive innovation in developing countries
- [Rethinking Resilience: Adapting to a changing climate](https://www.worldbank.org/en/publication/rethinking-resilience): Climate resilience and adaptation policy framework for developing economies facing climate shocks

## Institutional Information

- [Annual Report 2025](https://www.worldbank.org/en/about/annual-report): World Bank Group annual report on fiscal 2025 results and strategic priorities
- [Partnerships](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/work-with-us/partnerships): World Bank Group partnerships and collaboration opportunities for global development

## Optional

- [Project Procurement](https://www.worldbank.org/ext/en/what-we-do/project-procurement): Procurement framework, guidance, and business opportunities for World Bank-financed projects
